parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs national entry/facility exposure with a hostile state layer: foreign passports may face discrepancy refusal and, if wilful misrepresentation is found, lifetime fraud ineligibility; federal government-funded facilities are birth-sex only; this state removed gender-identity civil-rights remedy and bars stronger local protections; its school rule binds visitors to birth-certificate restrooms everywhere on school grounds, with only a guardian-consented single-person alternative. Custody interactions include hormone removal and reported immigration-custody abuse. No trans-presentation crime, organised sweeps, or death penalty are documented, and some orders are enjoined/litigated, so risk remains well above severe targeting but at unremedied universal-exposure level.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport X processing stopped, existing X valid to expiry; travellers reported confiscation/blocking. Entry cable: document/record discrepancy or reasonable doubt on sex requires refusal and more evidence; suspected wilful misrepresentation may support permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility, never automatic.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid until expiration; fraud finding requires four elements, limited waivers possible. Litigation over passport policy remains pending.
entry_documents.interaction: A document discrepancy at entry can become refusal/stranding and, if wilfully misrepresented, a permanent immigration bar, before any state facility or custody exposure arises.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted model mandating short haircuts, hormone-medication removal and psychiatric substitution described as conversion therapy; denial of care reported. Immigration custody reports include forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and severe sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No documented operative custody placement by gender identity or continuation of hormones; no documented remedy altering these practices.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any arrest, trespass charge, immigration detention or entry investigation routes the traveller into birth-sex facility and custody practices, with medication denial compounding other harms.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. State school rule requires everyone on school grounds, including visitors, to use multiperson restrooms/changing rooms matching birth certificate. A first-known trespass arrest under a comparable bathroom law involved 24 hours in men's ward.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Single-person school facility only with written guardian consent; not a general visitor right. No documented adult public-restroom statute in this state outside schools.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal birth-sex rule applies in government buildings generally; state school rule adds a stricter birth-certificate test on campuses, and state law bars localities from restoring stronger protections.

care_services.exposure: Gender-affirming care for under-18s banned in this state in 2023 and in 27 states nationally; proposed national rule would bar public-insurance reimbursement under 18. In custody, hormone medication is removed. Emergency ward placement for visitors is not documented.
care_services.protection: Historical litigation kept some adult surgery coverage available; no documented visitor emergency-care or medication-continuation protection.
care_services.interaction: A minor traveller or detained adult moves from a service setting into a custody/medication regime where care can be withdrawn, while facility placement follows birth sex.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal order defines sex as binary at birth, mandates assigned-sex documents, removes gender-ideology materials and pronoun policies. Counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; guidance lists 'radical gender ideology' among extreme viewpoints, though not as a reward criterion. Polling shows majority support for assigned-sex documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several executive orders have been blocked/enjoined; federal hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 2020 employment ruling remains nationally. No trans-presentation criminal offence documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat framing raises probability of document scrutiny and facility enforcement, while court injunctions create uneven, time-dependent protection.

minors_guardians.exposure: State school rule binds a trans minor visitor to birth-certificate facilities; single-person use requires written guardian consent. Care under 18 is banned. Federal order directs criminal prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition, including names/pronouns.
minors_guardians.protection: Guardian-consented single-person facility is documented; parental/guardian consent is the stated condition.
minors_guardians.interaction: An adult travelling with a minor faces combined school-facility, care-access and school-staff investigation exposure that a lone adult on a non-school itinerary may partly avoid, but federal facilities still apply.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state-specific homicide or violence figures are documented; monitoring counts are stated as undercount floors and are not used as a rate. Airport screening can be invasive and outing. Local violence prevalence for visitors is not established.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Federal bias-crime law covers gender identity, but only 23 states cover it in state bias statutes; this state removed state civil-rights protection in 2025, leaving no state gender-identity service remedy.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police or screening outing can trigger the documented document, facility and custody exposures; absence of a quantified violence rate is treated as undocumented, not as safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: State removed gender-identity protection from employment, housing and public accommodations from 1 July 2025, first state to withdraw existing protection, and in 2026 barred localities from stronger civil-rights protections. A refused traveller has no remedy under state law on that ground.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Federal courts, passport litigation, injunctions and legal-aid FAQ provide partial, unresolved routes; no documented effective remedy for facility exclusion or state service refusal.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: National litigation may restore some document/facility rights, but state pre-emption prevents local cure in the meantime, leaving the operative exposure unremedied at travel time.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar or slightly lower: both have unremedied birth-sex public facilities, document checks and courts rejecting exclusion complaints. This case adds entry discrepancy refusal with possible lifetime fraud finding, hormone removal in custody and removal of state remedy, making the interaction harsher.

Higher safety than this case: that anchor has repeated service hostility but working readmission/refunds, assault prosecution and no universal birth-sex facility or entry-fraud regime. Here remedies are absent at state level and universal exposure is documented.

Higher safety than this case: that anchor has repeated arrests, passport confiscation and extortion plus birth-sex custody as organised practice. Here no organised traveller sweeps/extortion or presentation offence is documented, and some measures are enjoined, so it sits above 0.25.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one system: a document discrepancy can lead to entry refusal or fraud scrutiny; inside, federal and state rules impose birth-sex facilities, with schools using birth certificates for visitors; state law removes service/housing/employment remedy and blocks local restoration; detention adds hormone withdrawal and reported abuse. Minors face school and care bans. Litigation, valid existing X passports and absence of a presentation crime prevent a severe-tier rating, but they do not cure the documented universal exposures.
